articles.title: Stocks to watch: Why these 16 shares will be in focus today
articles.summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS), a global leader in Engineering Intelligence Solutions and ER&D Consulting Services, has announced a partnership with Anthropic. This collaboration aims to significantly accelerate advancements in Engineering Intelligence, likely leveraging Anthropic's cutting-edge AI capabilities. The initiative will enhance LTTS's ER&D offerings, driving innovation and efficiency in engineering and research sectors through advanced technological integration.

articles.title: One-way 'speedboats with explosives' launched by US for first time
articles.summary: The United States military has, for the first time, deployed uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) – or one-way boat drones – as strike weapons in combat. This significant development in naval warfare technology marks a new era, with these autonomous systems directly engaging targets. The vessels were reportedly used against Iran, demonstrating a novel application of robotic combat capabilities.

articles.title: IN FOCUS: Have drones become the 'silver bullet' in wars?
articles.summary: Defence experts stress the importance of militaries investing in drone technology to avoid falling behind strategically. They contend that the necessity and scale of drone adoption depend on each nation's specific defence objectives and modern warfare goals. This underscores a critical evolution in military strategy and preparedness for future conflicts.

articles.title: Trump Drops Shipping Transit Fee, Says Hormuz Strait ‘Open to All Except Iran’
articles.summary: President Trump affirmed the Strait of Hormuz is open for international shipping, excluding Iranian vessels, a day after ordering Iranian port blockages. The U.S. military has restored passage, ensuring global trade can continue through the critical waterway. This move clarifies the U.S. stance, aiming to manage regional tensions and assert control over maritime security.
